title: My Most Vivid and Detailed Dream of Mall World (and sinking ship)
content: This was actually two seperate dreams, so I'll write them as such for easier reading. For context I had to put my dog down yesterday, so my grief is undoubtedly affecting my dreams. The first dream was extremely pleasant, almost euphoric. The second was a distressing nightmare. **Mall World** My husband was shopping with me in the mall, which is rare. Both stores we went to were new to me (the mall was the same as always), I've never dreamed of them before. We first went to a bead shop, that sold jewelry made with wood, beads, crystals and feathers. My husband picked a necklace with gold and brown beads, while I picked one with blue, purple and white crystals. My husband said it was too expensive so I put it back and settled for a red and black one. We left and continued wandering the mall as usual in these dreams. The next store caught my eye because they sold one specific item; Breyer model horses. I used to collect these as a kid so they're very sentimental to me. I noticed there was a little girl in the shop, about my age when I collected them. This model horse shop had a gimmick, you had to cover your eyes until you got to the til. Then the shop owner gave you 10 seconds to pick one model horse. I watched as the girl took her hands off her eyes and scanned the selection in amazement. I covered my eyes and waited my turn, perusing the horses with the same joy as the girl. I picked my horse and we paid and left. My husband and I went back to wandering the mall. It was busy, and I looked through the people to see two black ears poking out amidst the crowd and then I could make out a black German shepherd. My dog came running towards us, happier than ever. She wasn't sick anymore, and did something she used to do where she nuzzled her snout into us, while wagging her tail. As usual in my dreams with dead loved ones, I said "I thought you were dead! I'm so happy you're okay!!". My euphoric dream ended here. **Sinking Cruise Ship** I know this is a common dream here, so I figured I'd include it. I was on a cruise ship with my mom and sister, my mom had brought her two pugs. I was at the highest part of the ship which was the smoking section, I looked down over the railing at the ocean waves. I was having a cigarette next to this woman who was in her late 30s or early 40s. The ship started to move beneath us, and we heard a metallic shifting. I asked the woman if that's normal, she said she hoped so. We kept smoking until the movements became violent and the metallic noises got louder, I almost fell over the railing, but the woman caught me. She asked me if I was okay, and said we should get back into the ship. I managed to make my way into hallway where my room was located and ran into my mom and sister. They looked really upset, and I asked them what was wrong. They told me the ship was sinking, and the life boats wouldn't allow pets due to weight limits. My mom told me we would have to abandon her dogs to drown on the sinking ship, and escape with our lives. I was trying to think of a way to escape with them, I couldn't stand the thought of leaving them. Luckily this is where I woke up.
